title: 1950s Family Outdoor Portrait, B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century family portrait taken outdoors in a grassy area with dense foliage behind them. The family consists of a father in a white collared shirt and slacks, a mother in a structured suit jacket and eyeglasses, a young boy in a cardigan and trousers, and a young girl in a dress with a light jacket. The photograph features decorative scalloped deckle edges typical of 1940s and 1950s amateur snapshots.
